name: ios-remote-control
description: See and control a paired physical iPhone or iPad over Tailscale or any routed network, without WebDriverAgent or root.

interface.shortDescription: Control a paired iPhone or iPad over Tailscale
interface.longDescription: Take screenshots, launch apps, tap, swipe, and press Home on a paired physical iPhone or iPad from anywhere on your Tailscale network. The device must already be paired with your Mac. Requires the ios-remote command-line tool, which the skill helps install.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my iPad is reachable and show me its screen
